reviewFocus.en: This scoped brief covers selected release conditions, not every agentic workflow, billing change or platform requirement. Check the applicable offering, plan, database migration and beta support policy before deployment.
reviewFocus.ko: 선별한 릴리스 조건을 다룬 원고이며 모든 에이전트 기능·과금 변경·플랫폼 요구사항을 검증한 것은 아닙니다. 배포 전 제공 형태·요금제·데이터베이스 전환·베타 지원 정책을 확인할 것을 제안합니다.

en.title: GitLab 19.0: secret beta, dependency scanning and upgrade prerequisites

claims.text: In GitLab 19.0, Secrets Manager is an open beta for Premium and Ultimate customers on GitLab.com and Self-Managed. The release notes warn that the beta might not be ready for production use.

evidence.quote: The GitLab Secrets Manager is now available in open beta for Premium and Ultimate customers on GitLab.com and GitLab Self-Managed.
might not be ready for production use.

claims.text: SBOM-based dependency scanning is generally available in the Ultimate tier across GitLab.com, Self-Managed and Dedicated. Its availability and tier differ from the Secrets Manager beta.

evidence.quote: Dependency scanning by using SBOM generally available Tier: Ultimate Offering: GitLab.com, GitLab Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated

claims.text: For Self-Managed upgrades to GitLab 19.0, PostgreSQL 17 is the minimum supported version. The notes instruct users of packaged PostgreSQL 16 to upgrade the database before installing the release.

evidence.quote: The minimum supported version of PostgreSQL is now version 17.
If you use the packaged PostgreSQL 16, upgrade the packaged PostgreSQL server before installing GitLab 19.0.

claims.text: GitLab 19.0의 Secrets Manager는 GitLab.com과 Self-Managed의 Premium·Ultimate 고객을 위한 공개 베타다. 릴리스 문서는 베타가 운영 환경에 적합하지 않을 수 있다고 경고한다.

evidence.quote: The GitLab Secrets Manager is now available in open beta for Premium and Ultimate customers on GitLab.com and GitLab Self-Managed.
might not be ready for production use.

claims.text: SBOM 기반 의존성 검사는 GitLab.com·Self-Managed·Dedicated의 Ultimate 등급에서 정식 제공된다. Secrets Manager 베타와 제공 단계·등급이 다르다.

evidence.quote: Dependency scanning by using SBOM generally available Tier: Ultimate Offering: GitLab.com, GitLab Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated

claims.text: Self-Managed를 GitLab 19.0으로 올릴 때 최소 지원 데이터베이스 버전은 PostgreSQL 17이다. 문서는 패키지에 포함된 PostgreSQL 16 사용자가 릴리스 설치 전에 데이터베이스를 업그레이드하도록 안내한다.

evidence.quote: The minimum supported version of PostgreSQL is now version 17.
If you use the packaged PostgreSQL 16, upgrade the packaged PostgreSQL server before installing GitLab 19.0.
